v1.feedback: Strong execution of Cai Guo-Qiang's pyrotechnic aesthetic — Lucy explodes from gunpowder flash to ember char to dissipating smoke with proper temporal staging and palette (white-yellow → orange-red → gray-black). The hand-tracking ignition gesture is conceptually perfect but the timing feels slightly rushed; stretch the char phase from 0.4-1.2s to 0.5-1.8s for more lingering ember drama. Minor: the 'assembled' interpolation at t=0 could start particles more visibly condensed (scale entry by 0.05 not 0.1) so the explosion reads as more violent contrast.

The hand-pinch ignition mechanic elegantly bridges interaction and concept. Minor refinement: char phase could introduce more brownish-blacks (burnt paper tones) rather than pure orange-red to better capture the gunpowder residue aesthetic; consider slight rotational drift in smoke phase for more naturalistic dissipation.
